headline: A 2018 law renamed a Palmyra, Virginia post office after Navy Seaman Dakota Kyle Rigsby.
what_it_does: The law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 13683 James Madison Highway in Palmyra, Virginia, the "U.S. Navy Seaman Dakota Kyle Rigsby Post Office." It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or operations.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 24, 2018.
